audit_note: 2026-11-23 evidence-constrained update. Sm 0.646->0.649 (+0.003): GIE primary operator 22 Nov EU gas storage 781.10 TWh, 68.98% full; Germany 56.54%; 14 Nov EU 70.55% in prior audit. USDA 10 Nov WASDE forecasts 2026/27 world wheat ending stocks 280.82 Mt (+4.78 Mt) and corn 281.94 Mt (+1.50 Mt), offsetting grain buffer (forecast not measured stock). Sa 0.765 unchanged: Treasury certified November 2026 five-year rate 5% versus October 4-5/8%, not a decomposition of term premium; no new verified reinsurance/sovereign emergency-liquidity rupture. Sb 0.719 unchanged: no independently verified new births, first-homebuyer, youth delinquency or frontline care delivery release warrants a move. Sc 0.685 unchanged: WGC Q3 estimated official-sector gold buying 321.2t (+42% y/y), while publicly reported September +61t and reported year-to-date 228t (-7% y/y); these are distinct series. No newly verified physically commissioned hyperscaler power, implemented mineral-control or settlement shift. Phi 0.675 unchanged: last four history checkpoints have mixed directions (Sb fell last week); this week only Sm changes. rho1 0.726 unchanged: seasonal gas draw is not measured post-shock refill speed relative to recurrence. Weibull k 1.85 unchanged absent demonstrated accelerating global net infrastructure maintenance deficits. Heuristic proxies, coupling and hazard are not empirically calibrated to global regime-transition frequencies.
